rapport_notes: Confident and smooth close, handling the cancellation-policy objection directly and reassuringly.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked; call opens by confirming online-form details (address, partial-move inventory) directly.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: No-worries damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, and On-Time Guarantee were all delivered as a differentiator bundle; no rate-commit, window, beats-it, self-prep, or feel-fair lines were used.

top_strength: Made a direct close ask ('would you like to go ahead and get on the schedule today, Sam?') and handled the cancellation-policy question smoothly enough to convert it into a booking.
coaching_note: Never asked the agenda/concerns question before diving into confirming the online form's logistics — a quick check-in on concerns first would strengthen rapport before the estimate.
